This notebook writes the VS Code launch script.

The launch script should not install packages. It assumes prior notebooks have already installed and validated the environment.

```{python}
from simple_slurm import Slurm
from pathlib import Path
```

Importantly, we add a "clean" argument here; if True, it'll remove any existing
cached VSCode tunnel state found in `CONTAINER_HOME/.vscode-server`. This is 
useful if you want to reset the VSCode tunnel state, but it will also remove 
any cached extensions and settings. If you want to preserve your VSCode tunnel 
state, set `clean` to False.

```{python}
clean = True

runtime_command = [
    "set -euo pipefail",
    "source /work/env/activate.sh",
    "cd /work",
    "which code",
    "code tunnel user login --provider github",
    "rm -rf /home/rse/.vscode-server" if clean else "echo 'Preserving existing VSCode tunnel state'",
    f"code tunnel --accept-server-license-terms --name {project_contract.project_name}",
]
runtime_command
```

```{python}
slurm = Slurm(
    job_name=f"{project_contract.project_name}-vscode",
    cpus_per_task=project_contract.slurm_build_cpus,
    mem=project_contract.slurm_build_mem,
    time="04:00:00",
    partition=project_contract.slurm_build_partition,
    mail_user=project_contract.slurm_email,
    output=str(project_contract.launch_log_dir / "launch-%j.out"),
    error=str(project_contract.launch_log_dir / "launch-%j.err"),
)

slurm.add_cmd("set -o errexit -o nounset -o pipefail")
slurm.add_cmd(f'PROJECT_DIR="{project_contract.project_dir}"')
slurm.add_cmd('SIF="${PROJECT_DIR}/.devcontainer/Singularity.sif"')
slurm.add_cmd('CONTAINER_HOME="${PROJECT_DIR}/.container-home"')
slurm.add_cmd('CONTAINER_TMP="${PROJECT_DIR}/.container-tmp"')
slurm.add_cmd('mkdir -p "${PROJECT_DIR}/slurm/launch/logs"')
slurm.add_cmd('mkdir -p "${CONTAINER_HOME}" "${CONTAINER_TMP}"')
slurm.add_cmd('cd "${PROJECT_DIR}"')
```

```{python}
slurm.add_cmd(r'''
echo "=================== Slurm sitrep =================="
echo "Date:         $(date)"
echo "Host:         $(hostname)"
echo "User:         $(whoami)"
echo "Job ID:       ${SLURM_JOB_ID}"
echo "Project:      ${PROJECT_DIR}"
echo "SIF:          ${SIF}"
echo "Home:         ${CONTAINER_HOME}"
echo "Tmp:          ${CONTAINER_TMP}"
echo "==================================================="

module purge
''')
```

```{python}
container_command = " && ".join(runtime_command)

slurm.add_cmd(
    r'''singularity exec \
  --bind "${PROJECT_DIR}:/work" \
  --home "${CONTAINER_HOME}:/home/rse" \
  --bind "${CONTAINER_TMP}:/tmp" \
  "${SIF}" \
  bash --noprofile --norc -lc ''' + repr(container_command)
)
```

```{python}
project_contract.launch_script.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
project_contract.launch_script.write_text(slurm.script(convert=False))
project_contract.launch_script.chmod(0o755)
print(project_contract.launch_script.read_text())
```

Launch manually from the project directory:

```bash
sbatch "$LAUNCHSCRIPT"
```
